name: Quantum Gates and Circuits Benchmark
description: Evaluates and compares quantum gate and circuit performance across devices and simulators.
evaluation_method: gate / circuit fidelity (e.g., average gate fidelity, process fidelity, randomized benchmarking metrics, quantum volume)
general_score_metric: average gate fidelity / circuit fidelity (and derived metrics such as quantum volume or XEB fidelity)
typical_sota_score: single-qubit fidelity ~99–99.99%; two-qubit fidelity ~98–99.9%; end-to-end circuit fidelities vary widely (≈1%–90%) depending on depth and device
reputation: Widely used conceptually by the quantum hardware and benchmarking community, with multiple concrete suites (e.g., randomized benchmarking, quantum volume) adopted by device vendors and researchers.
notes: Non-LLM benchmark; device- and noise-dependent so cross-device comparisons require careful normalization; multiple distinct metrics exist (XEB, RB, quantum volume) and choice affects ranking; simulators may not reflect real-device noise.
